title: Reading related table definitions
description: You can identify keys and the relationship declared between two tables.

steps.description: Person declares person_id as its primary key and stores names and age. You can also see a CHECK expression attached to age.
Insurance declares its own primary key, a person_id column and provider and date fields. The start_date declaration includes a default expression.

steps.question: Which table and column does Insurance's foreign key reference?
steps.answer: It references person_id in Person, connecting an insurance record to a person key.

steps.description: You finish with two table declarations linked by the foreign key. The supplied trace visits both CREATE statements and shows no printed rows.
